rationale: The momentum that justified entry has visibly stalled — the two post-entry candles show a pullback to $41.10 and a recovery only back to $41.29, with volume dropping sharply from 25K to 16K and 11K, indicating the buying pressure cited at entry is dissipating. The take-profit at $42.20 requires a 2.2% advance in only 34 minutes with a widening spread (29 bps) and declining relative volume, making completion unlikely before close. Locking in a near-breakeven exit preserves the remaining daily loss budget rather than risking a drift back through the $41.03 9-EMA with time running out.
